messages:
jordan: Proposal: introduce a rollback safety-net for v2 rollouts that automatically routes affected tenants back to v1 when we detect production-quality regressions. want quick feedback on signal design + UX opt-in model. :thinking:

maya: sounds useful. what signals are you thinking? false positives worry me.

jordan: combine a few lightweight signals: 1) probe-eval regression vs baseline on a curated prompt set, 2) per-tenant spike in `generation_quality_drop` (heuristic), 3) rise in user-facing errors (5xx/timeout). require >=2 signals to fire within a 10m window.

sam: do not make it global — must be per-tenant and per-route. we already have route affinity keys. implementation: add a routing score computed at ingress and let the router prefer v1 when score > threshold. header: `X-Client-Version-Opt` can be used to override.

kevin: from product/console POV we need an explicit opt-in UI for tenant owners (default OFF). also show recent probe history and allow dry-run. non-tech admins should be able to understand why fallback triggered.

anita: ops question — who can trigger manual rollback? we should gate automatic rollbacks behind a safety window and a post-mortem hook. also need alerting when probes start firing so oncall can investigate before full rollback.

jordan: agreed. propose flow: 1) dry-run mode where routing score is computed but not applied, 2) optional auto-apply mode per-tenant, 3) global guard rails (rate limit how many tenants can auto-roll back per hour).

maya: telemetry details: we need to avoid churn from noisy prompts. suggest exponential smoothing + require 2 sigma over baseline and >0.3% of tenant traffic. also persist the probe prompts so we can audit.

sam: implementation notes: router changes small: compute `fallback_score = w1*probe_regression + w2*error_spike + w3*user_reports` and evaluate `fallback_score > 0.7` => route to v1. weights configurable per-tenant via console flags.

jordan: example probe config (dry-run):
```
{
  "probe_set": "v2-critical-prompts-2026-03",
  "window": "10m",
  "min_traffic_pct": "0.3",
  "threshold_sigma": "2",
  "require_signals": 2
}
```

kevin: UX: console should show a compact card: status (Dry-run | Auto-apply | Off), last fire time, brief reason, link to prompt examples and an "appeal" button to request manual review. also versioned audit trail.

anita: oncall runbook snippet: if probe fires -> page SRE -> check canary logs, sample a few recent prompts, check kernel/resource anomalies. if confirmed, either flip auto-apply or follow manual rollback steps. also notify tenant owner.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout/v2-safety-netting-branch to canary cluster a (sha: cafed00d).

console-bot: feature flag `v2_auto_fallback` created in console under Org > Flags > routing. default: off. can toggle per-tenant.

maya: risks: model mismatch where v1 legitimately degrades on certain prompts and v2 is actually better. need human review path and a short grace period to prevent flip-flopping.

jordan: plan for next steps: 1) small prototype: dry-run + telemetry dashboard (2 weeks), 2) UX mock for per-tenant card (1 week), 3) limited pilot with 5 low-risk tenants (2 weeks). I'll own prototype. who can pair on router changes?

sam: I can pair for the router bits. will sketch the fallback_score proto and an API for console to set weights.

kevin: I'll draft the console copy and mockups; product will own onboarding docs and tenant communication.

anita: I'll write the oncall runbook and alert thresholds.

jordan: thanks all — tagging follow-ups: @maya please create the telemetry issue, @kevin ux ticket, @sam router PR when ready. leaving this thread as the canonical convo for rollout plan. :thumbsup:
